theorem continuedPhysicalTimeAction_horizon_radial_laurent (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch side : Bool)

    ∃ (c₀ c₁ Φ : ℂ → ℂ),
      AnalyticAt ℂ c₀ (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ c₁ (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) ∧
      (∃ b C : ℝ, 0 < b ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side),
        ∀ z ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) b,
          ‖clearedDensityProfile q branch a zang u z - c₀ u - c₁ u * z‖ ≤ C * z ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[≠] (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side), Tendsto (fun L : ℝ =>
        (∫ t in L..0, ((tortoiseRadius t:ℂ) ^ 2 - 1) *
          continuedPhysicalTimeAction q branch u a false t zang) +
          (c₀ u * (horizonCoordinate L:ℂ) ^ u / u + c₁ u * (horizonCoordinate L:ℂ) ^ (u + 1) / (u + 1)) /
            reducedGreenClearingFactor u (physicalRadialFrequency q) (physicalRate q branch))
        atBot (𝓝 (Φ u))) ∧
      MeromorphicAt Φ (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) ∧
      laurentCoeff Φ (physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) (-1) =
        physicalRadialResidueFinitePart q branch side a zang

name: RHTower.D4BMMixedActionSource.literal_mixedPairedCoefficient_eq
source_signature:
theorem literal_mixedPairedCoefficient_eq (u aSp aVp aSm aVm : ℂ) (p : ExteriorPoint)
    (K L : Fin 4 → MetricField) (M : Mat)
    (hK : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => K a x i j) p.val)
    (hL : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => L a x i j) p.val) :
    let P := literalField true u aSp aVp
    let Q := literalField false u aSm aVm
    mixedPairedCoefficient p (literalModes u aSp aVp aSm aVm) K L M = ∑ i, ∑ j,
      (((actualJet p).metric⁻¹ * M * ((actualJet p).metric⁻¹).transpose) i j *
          (D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (L 1) p.val) i j +
            secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p (K 1)) +
            secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p Q) (fieldSpace p (K 0)) +
            thirdVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p Q) / 2) +
        testWeightSlope (actualJet p).metric (Q p.val) M i j *
          (D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (K 0) p.val) i j +
            secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p P) / 2) +
        testWeightSlope (actualJet p).metric (P p.val) M i j *
          (D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (K 1) p.val) i j +
            secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p Q)))

name: RHTower.D4BMMixedActionSource.literal_affine_mixedPairedCoefficient
source_signature:
theorem literal_affine_mixedPairedCoefficient (u aSp aVp aSm aVm : ℂ) (p : ExteriorPoint) (M : Mat) :
    let P := literalField true u aSp aVp
    let Q := literalField false u aSm aVm
    mixedPairedCoefficient p (literalModes u aSp aVp aSm aVm) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) M =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (((actualJet p).metric⁻¹ * M * ((actualJet p).metric⁻¹).transpose) i j *
            (thirdVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p Q) / 2) +
          testWeightSlope (actualJet p).metric (Q p.val) M i j *
            (secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p P) / 2) +
          testWeightSlope (actualJet p).metric (P p.val) M i j *
            secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p P) (fieldSpace p Q))

name: RHTower.D4BMMixedActionSource.mixedPairedCoefficient_of_quadratic_zero
source_signature:
theorem mixedPairedCoefficient_of_quadratic_zero (p : ExteriorPoint) (H K L : Fin 4 → MetricField) (M : Mat)
    (hH : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => H a x i j) p.val)
    (hK : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => K a x i j) p.val)
    (hL : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => L a x i j) p.val)
    (hfirst : ∀ a i j, deriv (source p (H a) i j) 0 = 0)
    (hpp : ∀ i j, D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (K 0) p.val) i j +
      secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)) / 2 = 0)
    (hpm : ∀ i j, D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (K 1) p.val) i j +
      secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 1)) = 0) :
    mixedPairedCoefficient p H K L M = ∑ i, ∑ j,
      ((actualJet p).metric⁻¹ * M * ((actualJet p).metric⁻¹).transpose) i j * mixedCoefficient p H K L i j

theorem sourceContact_eq (q : XiZeroCopy) (z : UpperHalfPlane) :
    sourceContact q (coordinates z)=

name: RHTower.D4BMSourceContactRigidity.sourceContact_differential_identity
source_signature:
theorem sourceContact_differential_identity (q : XiZeroCopy) (z : UpperHalfPlane) :
    (scalarParameter q-2)*(scalarParameter q-6)*(3*scalarParameter q-2)*
        scalar (center q) (coordinates z)^4=
      16*(scalarParameter q-2)*(scalarParameter q-6)*
        scalar (center q) (coordinates z)^2*sourceContact q (coordinates z)+
      64*(scalarParameter q-2)*
        (2*scalar (center q) (coordinates z)*scalarContactGradientPair q (coordinates z)+
          sourceContact q (coordinates z)*fullGradientEnergy q (coordinates z))-
      128*fullGradientEnergy q (coordinates z)*scalarLaplacian (sourceContact q) (coordinates z)-
      512*contactGradientEnergy q (coordinates z)
